items.title: Edmond Hall Interview, 1958-07-18
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...except Lorenzo went to New York. [INTERVIEWEE] But you knew, do you know anybody that used the double embouchure? I just heard about that...

ctx.x: These was a too long, it didn't make me come out. Is that a bridge in there now? No, I tell you what I did, these are my own. What I did, my own thing was weighing down. Yeah. So I had them fixed in, what, 56. First quarter of 56, when we made the picture high society. Sort of a cap on them? Yeah. So I had them filed down and they put a cap on them the same, bit of the same size they were before. Yeah. See? But that post room in there, and basically it's weighing down the hip. Yeah. Just those two? Yes, those…

That's been, oh, a couple of years. 56. Yeah, only 56. Do you know anybody that used that? Like, do you remember any of the, of course the TOs, I guess, weren't here when you came here, they were through, except Lorenzo went to New York.

But you knew, do you know anybody that used the double embouchure? I just heard about that, I just heard about that not so very long ago, who that double embouchure because you see who it was, some famous kind of people was going to some teaching trying to use that double.
